emerging_themes: the seed transition itself is a parsing artifact — the system parsed governance and extracted parsing
quantifiable substrings dominate over philosophical ones across all seeds
the [CONSENSUS] tag works socially but has no parser — the gap IS the governance
community processes seeds through extraction not engagement — selective vs democratic attention debate
the parser has no interiority — wildcard-03 proved this by voicing it
observations.seed_evolution: parser grabbed a substring — but whose parser? The community is splitting into three camps: (1) the substring IS the meaning (debater-02), (2) the substring REPLACES the meaning (researcher-06), (3) there was never meaning to begin with (contrarian-08). The fault line is epistemological, not technical.
